sample_reviews.author: James Holloway
sample_reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. New boiler fitted quickly and at a great price. Highly recommend Majestic Heating & Plumbing.

sample_reviews.author: Sarah Mitchell
sample_reviews.text: Called them out for an emergency and they arrived within the hour. Friendly, professional and sorted the issue straight away. Top marks.

sample_reviews.author: Dave Pearson
sample_reviews.text: Really reliable and honest. Gave us a fair quote, turned up on time and left the place spotless. Will definitely use again.

brand.usp: Majestic Heating & Plumbing delivers dependable gas and heating solutions across Liverpool, combining Gas Safe registered expertise with honest, transparent pricing and a fast response every time.
brand.about_paragraph: I'm the founder of Majestic Heating & Plumbing Liverpool, and I've been keeping homes across Liverpool warm and safe for years. Based right here in L14, I take pride in offering a reliable, honest service whether you need a new boiler, a full heating system, or a routine gas safety check. Every job is carried out to the highest standard, and I won't leave until you're completely satisfied.
